Sorry, Boss...
Made a pathetic fool outta myself again...

text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"With victory constantly slipping away like this,
I have to wonder what all the effort I've put in
up until today was even for..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Dammit!
What am I supposed to do with this?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Asking what I should do was pretty foolish of me.
I could've just asked you in the first place, couldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Tell me everything that's wrong with me
and how to fix it all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna give it my all again starting today
so I can run a whole lot better!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Heheh, you got me there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, whining about my own uselessness won't earn me a single penny. If I've got time for that, I might as well go run some laps.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, that kinda got my energy back up.
Alright... time to go get some special training in!
